column_description: TEXT. Identifier of the transaction related to this communication record. PK. FK to transactions(EventCode).

JSONB column. Stores metadata about communications related to transactions, including sentiment and message frequency.
Fields: {"comm_channel_type":"TEXT. Communication channel (e.g., forum PM, email). Possible values: External, Internal, Mixed.","comm_freq_type":"TEXT. Frequency classification of communications. Possible values: High, Low, Medium.","encryption_type":"TEXT. Type of encryption used in the communications. Possible values: Custom, Enhanced, Standard.","keyword_match_count":"BIGINT. Count of significant keyword matches detected. Example: 20.","lang_pattern_type":"TEXT. Language pattern or grammar classification inferred from messages. Possible values: Consistent, Suspicious, Variable.","msg_count_total":"BIGINT. Number of messages exchanged in the communication thread. Example: 36.","sentiment_val":"REAL. Sentiment-analysis score of the message corpus. Example: -0.69.","suspic_index_scr":"REAL. Suspicion score derived from content analysis. Example: 14.7."}
